posts.title: Shit to Do
posts.description: It’s been a busy few months, personally, professionally, socially, bike-ally. The randonneuring season has started. There was travel for work, and then non-travel work that nevertheless took up a lot of time. I’ve seen friends often, thankfully, and we’ve seen some good shows (LCD Soundsystem, a highlight). posts.description: I’ve got a copy of John Ashbery’s Some Trees on my phone, that I sometimes pick at while waiting for a train if I do not have another phone-book going.
